product.description: Pure Outdoor™ by Monoprice™Weatherproof Wheeled Hard Case with Customizable FoamLarge‑capacity, multipurpose customizable IP67 weatherproof hard caseThis Pure Outdoor™ Weatherproof Wheeled Hard Case is perfect for protecting your gear, whatever outdoor activities you choose.
